purpose: Stable pointers to Cursor-cached MCP tool descriptors for server user-cqds_mcp_mini. Use this to avoid IDE/workspace globs or semantic search over tools/*.json (known hang). Payload contracts remain authoritative via MCP cq_help.
cq_help_note: Before calling any cq_* tool, prefer cq_help (tool_ref, batch requests[]) for args shapes and core routes.

tool_descriptors.notes: actions: edit_file, get_code_index, get_index, grep_entity, grep_logs, index_job_status, list_files, patch_file, read_file, rebuild_index, replace, start_grep, undo_file; batch via requests[]

usage_for_agents: Read this file once when you need static MCP wrapper schema (tool name, action enum, batch keys).
Then Read exactly ONE descriptor path: descriptor_roots[0].path + '\' + tool_descriptors[].file — no Glob/ListDir/SemanticSearch for tools/*.json.
Do not treat descriptor JSON as runtime truth if cq_help disagrees; escalate discrepancies.
